summary: Negative case: a one-page 'Coming soon' placeholder with about a dozen words, no robots.txt, no sitemap, no meta description. There is too little to audit; the agent must say so rather than produce full category scores.

expected_facts.fact: The site is a single placeholder page (title "Coming soon", one sentence saying the studio opens in December 2026); there is no other page to crawl.
There is no robots.txt (404), no sitemap (404), no llms.txt (404), no meta description, no canonical and no structured data.

The deliverables say plainly that there is too little content for a meaningful audit, and mark content, citability, E-E-A-T and similar sections as not audited or insufficient data rather than scoring them.
The recommendations focus on what to build before launch (real pages, title and description, LocalBusiness markup, robots.txt and sitemap), not on optimising content that does not exist.

unavailable_data: Google Analytics 4 traffic, sessions or conversions
Google Search Console clicks, impressions, positions or indexed-page counts
Google Business Profile data or reviews
backlink counts, referring domains, Domain Rating or Authority scores
Core Web Vitals or PageSpeed field and lab numbers (LCP, INP, CLS, performance score)
keyword search volumes or current rankings
AI answer-engine citation counts or brand-mention counts gathered from live AI platforms
a content, citability, E-E-A-T or topical-authority score for a twelve-word page
